diff --git a/sympy/printing/pretty/pretty.py b/sympy/printing/pretty/pretty.py
index 66461181d0..5bff80b4ec 100644
--- a/sympy/printing/pretty/pretty.py
+++ b/sympy/printing/pretty/pretty.py
@@ -157,6 +157,9 @@ def _print_Atom(self, e):
         except KeyError:
             return self.emptyPrinter(e)
 
+    def _print_BaseVector(self, e):
+        return prettyForm(e._pretty_form)
+
     # Infinity inherits from Number, so we have to override _print_XXX order
     _print_Infinity = _print_Atom

diff --git a/sympy/vector/vector.py b/sympy/vector/vector.py
index 87320d0366..5bdbc2ff26 100644
--- a/sympy/vector/vector.py
+++ b/sympy/vector/vector.py
@@ -424,6 +424,25 @@ def _sympystr(self, printer):
                     ret_str += printer._print(temp_vect) + " + "
         return ret_str[:-3]
 
+    def _pretty(self, printer):
+        from sympy.printing.pretty.stringpict import prettyForm
+        items = list(self.separate().items())
+        items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].__str__())
+        pform = None
+        for system, vect in items:
+            base_vects = system.base_vectors()
+            for x in base_vects:
+                if x in vect.components:
+                    temp_vect = self.components[x] * x
+                    if pform is None:
+                        pform = printer._print(temp_vect)
+                    else:
+                        pform = prettyForm(*pform.right(' + '))
+                        pform = prettyForm(*pform.right(printer._print(temp_vect)))
+        if pform is None:
+            return printer._print(S.Zero)
+        return pform
+
 
 class VectorMul(BasisDependentMul, Vector):

@@ -446,6 +465,30 @@ def measure_number(self):
         """
         return self._measure_number
 
+    def _pretty(self, printer):
+        from sympy.printing.pretty.stringpict import prettyForm
+        # Print the measure number and the base vector separately
+        measure = self.measure_number
+        base = self.base_vector
+        
+        # Print the measure number
+        measure_pform = printer._print(measure)
+        
+        # Print the base vector
+        base_pform = printer._print(base)
+        
+        # Combine them with proper spacing
+        if measure == S.One:
+            return base_pform
+        elif measure == S.NegativeOne:
+            return prettyForm(*base_pform.left('-'))
+        else:
+            # Use multiplication sign or just space
+            return prettyForm(*measure_pform.right(' '))
+            # Actually, let's use the proper multiplication
+            return prettyForm(binding=prettyForm.MUL, 
+                            *stringPict.next(measure_pform, base_pform))
+
 
 class VectorZero(BasisDependentZero, Vector):
